summary: This directory contains the testing suite for the project snapshot system. It validates the end-to-end functionality of capturing, comparing, and managing project state snapshots to ensure consistency and correct change detection across file systems.
responsibilities: Verify the integrity of project state snapshots
Validate file hashing and enumeration logic
Test the mechanisms for creating, deleting, and diffing snapshots
Ensure project workspace workspace setup and environmental consistency
Analyze project changes via integration and unit testing
relationships: The project workspace serves as the foundation for creating and managing snapshots of the file system.
File hash entries are generated during snapshot creation to enable accurate change detection and diffing.
Change analysis relies on comparing multiple snapshots to determine differences in the project structure.
designDecisions: Segregation of unit tests for specific snapshot logic from integration tests for complete workflow verification
Focus on state-based testing to ensure reliable snapshot lifecycle management
